hypothesis_map.relation_note: H036 custom scientific v1 is implemented and frozen. Policy Distillation/P&C/CLEAR inform behavior fitting and protection of the current keep-initialization prior; Distral/CPC are shared-integration background and DMPEL is conditional structure context. Full cited methods are not reproduced, and their results or guarantees are not inherited. E163 run002 validly completed the fixed-v1 necessary KL screen: 32 fits and 16 prefixes, with 8/16 below the predefined 12/16 gate, so the screen outcome is NO_ADVANCEMENT and H036 remains INCONCLUSIVE. Of the passing items, 7 satisfy D != C0; the other (seed 26209) validly returns C0 and cannot be attributed to learned protection. Independent 1,876 checks had zero failures; environment interactions and GPU use were zero. Fixed v1 is stopped; no lambda search, Stage A, new seed, or new fit is authorized. Preserve run001 ACCOUNTING_INVALID and UNKNOWN complete cost; E163 cumulative complete cost is UNKNOWN. E164 is COMPLETE_VALID / EXPLORATORY_ONLY: 5 fits, 10 new scoring packages, 16 logical pairs, zero environment interactions and GPU use; its reservation is closed and no next phase is authorized. UG-V is exactly zero across all 16 pairs. UR-UG lowers old KL in 5 pairs, while G_new improves in 2, declines in 3, and is unchanged in 11. This finite diagnostic on previously seen E161/E163 data identifies an old-protection/new-fit tradeoff, does not confirm H036, and is not independent new-seed confirmation. The final a003 audit was performed on a separate copy with offline metadata/runtime mapping corrections; the campaign was not rerun, and earlier INVALID/INCOMPLETE audit evidence remains preserved. No new literature or novelty claim is added.

documented_relation_cases.documented_relation: The H004 protocol names LoRA, Wanda, and knowledge distillation as inspiration for custom residual compression/repair and explicitly says the arms are not faithful reproductions. The broader related-work note separately cites Eckart–Young for the best rank-r approximation; it is a useful cross-link candidate, but not directly listed in H004.

EWC is a task-free empirical-Fisher PPO adaptation; replay is CLEAR-inspired, partial, and not a CLEAR reproduction; Progress & Compress is contextual and was not implemented; LoRA-XS and PG-ELLA are precedents; TreeLoRA/CPC are cited as prior work. CPC is in the canonical bibliography as He2026CPC; it is cited as background, not as an implemented experimental baseline.

The H record says Policy Distillation, Progress & Compress, and DaCoRL were actually adopted as partial mechanisms. Modular Lifelong RL, restarted BOCPD, and SPIBB appear as context with explicit scope limits, not full implementations.

The source record says local learning/slow integration and dynamics-based routing were borrowed as inspiration; TRPO is referenced to distinguish the sampling behavior distribution. The implementation is not a full reproduction and does not inherit guarantees.
projected_gate borrows the bounded-reference / gradient-conflict idea from A-GEM and PCGrad as a custom adaptation; it is explicitly not either paper algorithm.

The source-dose experiment is a targeted response to literature concerns about source exposure, order, and candidate maturity; the source review uses Target Shift to motivate isolating these factors. This is design motivation, not transfer of a theorem.

Behavior compression borrows a shared behavior-distribution fitting idea from Policy Distillation and Distral, with a learning/consolidation staging analogy to Progress & Compress; the protocol says the custom 9-coefficient candidate is not a full reproduction and distillation itself is not a new contribution.

Design/prior-art and proposed comparison context only. The source documents explicitly state these works do not establish the project method, and no full dynamic C2/C3 or structure comparison was run.
